description: This file contains unit tests for internal unordered_map modifier functions in the Abseil C++ library, including tests for insertions, erasures, and capacity handling, with special cases for unique_ptr value types.

classes.name: ModifiersTest
classes.description: Template class for testing various modifier functions of unordered_map.

classes.name: UniquePtrModifiersTest
classes.description: Template class for testing unordered_map modifier functions with std::unique_ptr value types.

methods.name: InsertRange
methods.description: Test inserting a range of elements.

methods.name: InsertWithinCapacity
methods.description: Test inserting elements without exceeding capacity.

methods.name: InsertRangeWithinCapacity
methods.description: Test inserting a range within capacity constraints.

methods.name: InsertOrAssignHint
methods.description: Test insert or assign with hint (C++17).

methods.name: EraseRange
methods.description: Test erasing a range of elements.
